summary: 69-year-old man with an end colostomy (abdominoperineal resection 3 years ago) and a growing parastomal bulge causing appliance leaks and intermittent colicky pain. EHS 2018: CT when uncertain, mesh repair rather than suture repair, stoma nurse input; check for recurrence of rectal cancer.

inputs.chiefComplaint: Bulge around my stoma and bag leaks
inputs.hpi: End colostomy after APR for low rectal cancer 3 years ago (clear surveillance CT last year). Bulge around the stoma over the past year, bag leaks twice a week, crampy pain once or twice a month that settles. Stoma working normally. No vomiting.

exam.abdomen: Left iliac fossa end colostomy, healthy and pink. Reducible parastomal hernia, about 8 cm bulge, cough impulse, non-tender. Perineal wound healed.

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Symptomatic parastomal hernia (end colostomy)
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Symptomatic reducible parastomal hernia around end colostomy — appliance leaks and intermittent pain. CT abdomen (hernia content, exclude recurrence), stoma nurse review, consider mesh repair.

mustRankTopK.knownGapNote: PANE applied no feature ("Incisional / ventral hernia" template, no CC hint); inguinal hernia leads on the male prior. PANE: unlisted features count at DEFAULT_SENSITIVITY 0.30 for every disease and there is no false-positive term, so high-prior abdominal diseases (cholecystitis 0.15, GORD 0.12, PUD 0.10; male inguinal hernia x5) outrank the organ-specific disease after a single non-abdominal feature.

emergencyLevel.knownGapNote: Triage emergency_now (score 59): adaptiveTriage RED_FLAGS regexes have no negation handling ("No vomiting"); "rectal cancer" history → "Possible malignancy".
emergencyLevel.proposedFix: Add a negation window ("no", "denies", "never", "non-") before RED_FLAGS / symptom regex matches in adaptive-triage.

guideline.name: EHS guidelines — prevention and treatment of parastomal hernias
guideline.section: Diagnosis (clinical ± CT); indication for repair; mesh repair rather than suture repair; stoma relocation
guideline.citation: Antoniou SA, Agresta F, Garcia Alamino JM, et al. European Hernia Society guidelines on prevention and treatment of parastomal hernias. Hernia. 2018;22:183–198.

rationale: Base parastomal case. All quality: guideline concordance of the plan (CT, mesh, stoma care).
